prompt: 哪一句分詞構句才是正確的？
options: Walking along the river, I saw a heron.
Walk along the river, I saw a heron.
Walked along the river, I saw a heron.
answer: Walking along the river, I saw a heron.

原形動詞不能當分詞構句開頭；主動、同時進行的動作要用現在分詞 Walking。
過去分詞表示被動或完成，但 I 是主動走路的人，應該用 Walking。

why: I 是主動做 walk 的人，且兩個動作同時發生，所以用現在分詞 Walking。
tip: 主動同時：V-ing 分詞構句。
say: Walking along the river, I saw a heron.

prompt: 選出適合填入空格的字。
text: The novel, _____ was written in 1930, is still popular today.
options: which
what
who

wrong.what: what 不能引導修飾 novel 的關係子句，它本身包含先行詞的意思。
wrong.who: who 指人，但先行詞 novel 是物，要用 which。

why: 先行詞 The novel 是物，非限定關係子句用逗號加 which，並作 was written 的主詞。
tip: 逗號後補充說明物：, which。
say: The novel, which was written in 1930, is still popular today.

prompt: 這個句子的意思是什麼？
text: Not until the rain stopped did we leave the shelter.
options: 雨停了我們才離開避難處。
我們離開後雨才停。
雨一直下，所以我們都沒離開。
answer: 雨停了我們才離開避難處。

wrong.我們離開後雨才停。: Not until A did B 表示 A 發生之後 B 才發生，順序與此選項相反。
wrong.雨一直下，所以我們都沒離開。: 句中 we did leave，最後有離開，只是等雨停後才離開。

why: Not until + 子句 + 倒裝主句，表示「直到……才……」。
tip: Not until 放句首，主句要倒裝。
say: Not until the rain stopped did we leave the shelter.

prompt: 哪一句假設語氣才是正確的？
options: If I were you, I would talk to the teacher.
If I was you, I will talk to the teacher.
If I am you, I would talk to the teacher.
answer: If I were you, I would talk to the teacher.

wrong.If I was you, I will talk to the teacher: 與現在事實相反的假設，主句要用 would，不是 will；正式寫作也慣用 were。
wrong.If I am you, I would talk to the teacher: if 子句用 am 是直述語氣，無法表達與事實相反的假設，要用 were。

why: 與現在事實相反：If + 主詞 + were／過去式，主句用 would + 原形動詞。
tip: 與現在事實相反：If I were..., I would...。
say: If I were you, I would talk to the teacher.

prompt: 選出適合填入空格的字。
text: Never _____ I seen such a beautiful sunset.
options: have
I have
had been

wrong.I have: Never 放句首要倒裝成 have I seen，不能保持 I have 的順序。
wrong.had been: had been seen 變成被動，也不符合 have I seen 的現在完成式倒裝。

why: 否定副詞 Never 放句首，助動詞提前：Never have I seen。
tip: Never 開頭，助動詞放主詞前。
say: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.

prompt: 你要在作文中表達：因為已經讀過資料，她很快就回答了問題。哪一句最自然？
options: Having read the data, she answered the question quickly.
Have read the data, she answered the question quickly.
Having been read the data, she answered the question quickly.
answer: Having read the data, she answered the question quickly.

wrong.Have read the data, she answered the que: 分詞構句要用分詞形式，Have read 不能這樣當開頭。
wrong.Having been read the data, she answered: Having been read 是被動，意思變成她被資料讀，主詞與動作關係不通。

why: 先讀完資料再回答，用完成式分詞構句 Having + 過去分詞，表示動作在前。
say: Having read the data, she answered the question quickly.

prompt: 句中的 chosen for the contest 在文法上有什麼功能？
text: The students chosen for the contest practiced daily.
options: 修飾 students，表示被選中參賽的學生
說明學生選了什麼比賽
表示學生每天選擇練習
answer: 修飾 students，表示被選中參賽的學生

wrong.說明學生選了什麼比賽: chosen 是過去分詞，表示被選中，不是學生自己去選比賽。
wrong.表示學生每天選擇練習: practiced daily 才是主要動詞片語，chosen... 是修飾名詞的分詞片語。

why: 過去分詞片語 chosen for the contest 等於 who were chosen...，表被動並修飾 students。
tip: 後置修飾：名詞 + p.p. 表被動。
say: The students chosen for the contest practiced daily.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The boy whose bike was stolen reported it to the police.
The boy who bike was stolen reported it to the police.
The boy which bike was stolen reported it to the police.
answer: The boy whose bike was stolen reported it to the police.

wrong.The boy who bike was stolen reported it: who 不能直接加名詞表示所有關係，要用 whose bike（他的腳踏車）。
wrong.The boy which bike was stolen reported i: which 用於物，先行詞 boy 是人，而且表示所有也要用 whose。

why: whose + 名詞 表示所有關係，whose bike = the boy's bike。
say: The boy whose bike was stolen reported it to the police.

prompt: 選出適合填入空格的字。
text: If it _____ tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
options: rains
will rain
rained

wrong.will rain: if 引導的條件句中，未來的事用現在式，不能再用 will。
wrong.rained: 過去式在 if 子句會變成與現在事實相反的假設，但這裡是真實可能的明天。

why: 真實條件句：If + 現在式，主句用 will + 原形動詞。
tip: if 子句不用 will，用現在式。
say: If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.

prompt: 你想表達：直到老師解釋後，我才完全明白這個句子。哪一句最好？
options: Only after the teacher explained it did I fully understand the sentence.
Only after the teacher explained it I did fully understand the sentence.
Only after the teacher explained it, I fully understood the sentence did.
answer: Only after the teacher explained it did I fully understand the sentence.

wrong.Only after the teacher explained it I di: Only + 副詞片語放句首時，主句要倒裝成 did I，不是 I did。
wrong.Only after the teacher explained it, I f: did 被放到句尾，語法完全錯誤；倒裝必須把助動詞放在主詞前。

why: Only after... 放句首，後面主句倒裝，助動詞 did 放主詞 I 前，動詞用原形。
tip: Only + 副詞片語開頭，主句倒裝。
say: Only after the teacher explained it did I fully understand the sentence.

prompt: Had I known about the test, I would have studied. 這句話表示什麼？
text: Had I known about the test, I would have studied.
options: 我當時不知道考試，所以沒有讀書。
我知道考試，所以讀了書。
我以後會知道考試，然後讀書。
answer: 我當時不知道考試，所以沒有讀書。

wrong.我知道考試，所以讀了書。: 這是與過去事實相反的假設，真實情況正好是沒有知道、沒有讀書。
wrong.我以後會知道考試，然後讀書。: Had I known 與 would have studied 都在談過去，不是談未來。

why: Had + 主詞 + p.p. 是省略 if 的過去假設，意思是 If I had known。
tip: Had S p.p. = If S had p.p.，與過去相反。
say: Had I known about the test, I would have studied.
